_help: Hand-picked links. Paste any URL: an article, an X post, a TikTok or YouTube video, an Instagram or Facebook post.
The build fetches the page's title, description and image (Open Graph) or uses the platform's public oEmbed endpoint.
Fields: url (required), title, summary, image, author, source, note, added (date), pinned (true/false), enabled (false hides it).
Anything you type here overrides what was fetched. Instagram and Facebook block bots, so give those a title (and ideally an image).
Optional "categories": a list of tab ids from feeds.json (e.g. ["holyspirit"]) to show the pick in those tabs as well as Picks.
Pinned picks lead Top Stories. Examples:

picks.title: Nigerian Christian mother jailed 14 years in Borno State for sharing her faith
picks.summary: Liatu Samuel Dawa was sentenced to 14 years in prison in Borno State after a woman she shared her faith with converted from Islam to Christianity. The convert testified she acted freely. Rights advocates call the ruling a breach of Nigeria's constitutional freedom of religion.
picks.note: Reported by Truth Nigeria and Starconnect Media; no international wire coverage yet. Pray for Liatu and her family.

picks.title: Saudi Arabia executes two Bangladeshis for an 'immoral act' inside a Mecca mosque
picks.summary: Saudi Arabia's Interior Ministry says a Bangladeshi man and woman were executed on 14 October for an act it called immoral inside a mosque in Mecca. The statement did not say what the act was. Bangladesh says it was not told in advance.
picks.note: The official statement does not describe the act; the 'forehead kiss' and 'newlyweds' details in the post are unverified. Confirmed by AP and The Daily Star.
